channel.title: K C B Inc - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from K C B Inc (kcbs.com)

item.title: Travelers stranded after Iran war closes airspace in the Middle East
item.description: More than 2,400 flights were canceled Sunday across airports in the Middle East, according to flight tracker FlightAware.

item.title: Texas gunman wore "Property of Allah" hoodie during attack, sources say
item.description: The man who killed two and wounded 14 also had photos of Iranian leaders in his home, a source said.

item.title: 2/25: The Takeout with Major Garrett
item.description: President Trump touts economy, immigration policies in State of the Union address; Virginia Gov. Abigail Spanberger hits Trump on affordability in Democrat response.

item.title: Setting sail on iceboats across a frozen lake in Wisconsin
item.description: CBS News' Noel Brennan hits a frozen lake in Wisconsin to go ice sailing.

item.title: World leaders and governments react to U.S.-Israeli attacks on Iran
item.description: U.S. allies and adversaries responded to the joint attacks by the U.S. and Israel on Iran with concern over the risks of a new war in the Middle East.

item.title: James Talarico on his economic message, Jasmine Crockett and more
item.description: Texas State Rep. James Talarico, Democratic candidate for U.S. Senate, speaks with CBS News' Ed O'Keefe about his affordability platform, his primary opponent U.S. Rep. Jasmine Crockett and more.

item.title: 3/1: CBS Weekend News
item.description: Another wave of U.S. strikes on Iran; Iran launches strikes across Gulf countries.

item.title: 3/1/2026: Iran; Under Siege; Breaking the Cycle
item.description: First, Reza Pahlavi on the future of Iran. Then, a look at threats against U.S. judges under Trump. And, breaking the cycle of school shootings.

item.title: Trump says Iran operation could take "four weeks or less," 3 U.S. troops killed
item.description: The U.S. military says three troops have been killed in the war with Iran, as President Trump says the operation is proceeding "ahead of schedule." Follow live updates.

item.title: 3/1: Sunday Morning
item.description: Hosted by Jane Pauley. Featured: A memorial to Operation Desert Storm; Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei; Dana White, the head of UFC; Jack Schlossberg; composer Marc Shaiman; and an digital art exhibit in the Arizona desert.
